tools.name: get_recent_earthquakes
tools.description: Returns recent seismic events from the Icelandic Meteorological Office (Veðurstofa Íslands, api.vedur.is/quakes), filtered by minimum magnitude, lookback hours (1-168), and optional region/seismic zone, newest first (max 20).

tools.name: get_volcano_status
tools.description: Returns current aviation color codes (VONA) and volcanic alert levels (VALS) for Icelandic volcanic systems from Veðurstofa Íslands (api.vedur.is/volcanoes), sorted with elevated unrest first (max 20).

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Returns latest live weather station observations from Veðurstofa Íslands (api.vedur.is/weather 10-min AWS & SYNOP) and optional short-term XML forecast (xmlweather.vedur.is) for a town or station in Iceland.

tools.name: get_weather_warnings
tools.description: Returns active Common Alerting Protocol (CAP) weather and natural-hazard warnings from Veðurstofa Íslands (api.vedur.is/cap), returning an explicit empty state when none are active (max 20).

tools.name: get_road_conditions
tools.description: Returns live Icelandic road surface conditions, closures, weight restrictions, and regional advisories from IRCA / Vegagerðin (umferdin.is/graphql with gagnaveita.vegagerdin.is REST fallback), ranked with hazards first (max 20).
